title: Leah Randall’s “Tend To Me” (feat. Robotikus) blends soulful meditation with pleasant intrigue
htmlContent: Leah Randall's new single, "Tend To Me," featuring Robotikus, creates a personal and uplifting atmosphere, pulling you in right from the catchy chorus that sticks with you. Recorded in Robotikus' studio in Lutana, Hobart, the track beautifully balances self reflection with an inspiring sense of hope. The lyrics dive into the complicated nature of seeking approval, who we seek it from, and why it matters. The gentle chimes, found under Scott's house, add a lovely touch and highlight that creativity can come from the most surprising places. This attention to detail shows not only Leah's talent but also Robotikus' skill in creating productions that enhance the song's story. https://open.spotify.com/track/6sxwJwwMJKOW5SUk22b0n9 "Tend To Me" resonates with anyone trying to find their way while holding onto hope for a brighter future. With its catchy chorus, beautifully haunting bridge, and creative sound choices, "Tend To Me" establishes Leah Randall as an artist who crafts memorable experiences. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram
